label.en: destroyed Buddhist temples / banned improper ordination

units.zh: 卷十二 周本纪第十二
units.en: Volume 12 — Annals of Zhou, Chapter 12
units.literal: Volume Twelve. Annals of Zhou, Chapter Twelve

units.zh: 世宗睿武孝文皇帝，本姓柴氏，邢州龙冈人也。
units.en: Shizong, temple name the Sagacious Martial Filial Civil Emperor, was born of the Chai clan at Longgang in Xingzhou.
units.literal: Shizong, the Sagacious Martial Filial Civil Emperor—original surname Chai, a native of Longgang in Xingzhou.

units.zh: 柴氏女适太祖，是为圣穆皇 后。
units.en: A Chai clanswoman wed Taizu and was enthroned as Empress Shengmu.
units.literal: A daughter of the Chai clan married Taizu; she became Empress Shengmu.

units.zh: 后兄守礼子荣，幼从姑长太祖家，以谨厚见爱，太祖遂以为子。
units.en: Rong, Shouli’s son and the empress’s nephew, was raised from boyhood in Taizu’s house through his aunt; his sober loyalty won affection, and Taizu adopted him as a son.
units.literal: Rong, son of the empress’s brother Shouli, in youth followed his aunt who had grown up in Taizu’s household; for his careful steadiness he was beloved, and Taizu thus made him his son.

units.zh: 太祖后稍贵， 荣亦壮，而器貌英奇，善骑射，略通书史黄老，性沈重寡言。
units.en: As Taizu’s star rose, Rong matured into a man of striking looks and presence, expert in the saddle and bow, with a modest grounding in the classics, histories, and Daoist texts, and a temperament grave and quiet.
units.literal: After Taizu later rose somewhat in rank, Rong also came of age; his bearing and appearance were heroic and striking, he was skilled at mounted archery, had slight knowledge of texts, histories, and Yellow Emperor–Laozi learning, and by nature was grave and sparing of words.

units.zh: 太祖为汉枢密使， 荣为左监门卫大将军。
units.en: While Taizu served Later Han as privy commissioner, Rong held the post of Grand General of the Left Gate Guard.
units.literal: When Taizu was Han’s privy commissioner, Rong was Grand General of the Left Gate Guard.

units.zh: 太祖镇天雄，荣领贵州刺史、天雄军牙内都指挥使。
units.en: When Taizu took command at Tianxiong, Rong became prefect of Guizhou and commander-in-chief of the Tianxiong inner guard.
units.literal: When Taizu garrisoned Tianxiong, Rong held the posts of prefect of Guizhou and commander-in-chief of the Tianxiong army’s inner guard.

units.zh: 乾祐三年冬，周兵起魏，犯京师，留荣守魏。
units.en: In the winter of Qianyou 3 the Zhou army rose in Wei and struck for the capital; Rong stayed behind to guard Wei.
units.literal: In winter of Qianyou 3, Zhou troops rose in Wei and marched on the capital; Rong was left to hold Wei.

units.zh: 太祖入立，拜澶州刺史、镇宁 军节度使，检校太傅、同中书门下平章事。
units.en: After Taizu seized the throne, Rong was made prefect of Chan, military commissioner of Zhenning, honorary grand tutor, and associate grand councilor.
units.literal: When Taizu entered and took the throne, Rong was appointed prefect of Cao, military commissioner of Zhenning, honorary grand tutor, and associate grand councilor.

units.zh: 荣素为枢密使王峻所忌，广顺三年正 月来朝，不得留。
units.en: Privy Commissioner Wang Jun had long resented Rong; when Rong came to court in the first month of Guangshun 3, he was sent back and not allowed to remain.
units.literal: Rong had long been envied by Privy Commissioner Wang Jun; in the first month of Guangshun 3 he came to court and was not permitted to stay.

units.zh: 既而峻有罪诛，三月，拜荣开封尹，封晋王。
units.en: Jun was soon condemned and put to death; in the third month Rong became Mayor of the Eastern Capital and Prince of Jin.
units.literal: Before long Jun was guilty and executed; in the third month Rong was appointed Mayor of the Eastern Capital and enfeoffed as Prince of Jin.

units.zh: 是冬，卜以来年 正月朔旦有事于南郊，而太祖遇疾，不能视朝者久之。
units.en: That winter auguries fixed the southern suburb rite for dawn on the coming new year, yet Taizu fell ill and went long without holding court.
units.literal: That winter they divined to perform the southern suburb rite at dawn on the new year of the coming year; but Taizu fell ill and for a long time could not hold court.

units.zh: 显德元年正月丙子，郊，仅而成礼，即以王判内外兵马事。
units.en: On bingzi in the first month of Xiande 1 the suburban sacrifice was rushed through; the Prince of Jin was then put in charge of all military affairs within and without.
units.literal: On bingzi in the first month of Xiande 1 the suburb rite was performed and barely completed; the Prince was then appointed to judge inner and outer military affairs.

units.zh: 壬辰，太祖崩， 秘不发丧。
units.en: On renchen Taizu died; the court concealed the death and withheld the mourning proclamation.
units.literal: On renchen Taizu died; the death was kept secret and mourning not announced.

units.zh: 丙申，发丧，皇帝即位于柩前。
units.en: On bingshen the mourning was proclaimed and the new emperor took the throne before the bier.
units.literal: On bingshen mourning was announced and the emperor acceded before the coffin.

units.zh: 于书封晋王，正其非子矣。其余假窃嗣君之礼，不待讥贬而可知，故皆无异辞。
units.en: By recording the enfeoffment as Prince of Jin, the annals expose the fiction that he was a true son. The other stolen rites of succession need no added rebuke or praise; the facts speak for themselves, and the text therefore gives them without comment.
units.literal: In recording the enfeoffment as Prince of Jin, the annals correct the false claim of true sonship. The other usurped rites of a succeeding sovereign need no explicit censure or praise—the facts themselves make the impropriety plain, and so the text records them without further comment.

units.zh: 右监门卫大将军魏仁浦为枢密副使。
units.en: Wei Renpu, Grand General of the Right Gate Guard, became vice privy commissioner.
units.literal: Wei Renpu, Grand General of the Right Gate Guard, was made vice privy commissioner.

units.zh: 二月庚戌，回鹘遣使者来。
units.en: On gengxu in the second month Uyghur envoys arrived.
units.literal: On gengxu in the second month the Uyghurs sent envoys.

units.zh: 丁卯，冯道为大行皇帝山陵使，太常卿田敏为礼仪使， 兵部尚书张昭为卤簿使，御史中丞张煦为仪仗使，开封少尹权判府事王敏为桥道 顿递使。
units.en: On dingmao Feng Dao was named mausoleum commissioner for the late emperor; Tian Min, Minister of Rites, oversaw ritual; Zhang Zhao, Minister of War, insignia; Zhang Xu, Vice Censor-in-Chief, ceremonial guards; and Wang Min, junior mayor of Kaifeng acting as mayor, bridges, roads, and relays.
units.literal: On dingmao Feng Dao was made commissioner for the late emperor’s mausoleum, Minister of Rites Tian Min commissioner of ritual, Minister of War Zhang Zhao commissioner of insignia, Vice Censor-in-Chief Zhang Xu commissioner of ceremonial guards, and Junior Mayor of Kaifeng Wang Min, acting mayor, commissioner of bridges, roads, and relay stations.

units.zh: 汉人来讨，攻自潞州。
units.en: Northern Han forces marched to punish Zhou, advancing from Luzhou.
units.literal: The Han came to attack, pressing from Luzhou.

units.zh: 三月辛巳，大赦。
units.en: On xinsi in the third month a general amnesty was proclaimed.
units.literal: On xinsi in the third month, a general amnesty.

units.zh: 癸未，郑仁诲留守东京。
units.en: On guiwei Zheng Renhui was posted to guard the Eastern Capital.
units.literal: On guiwei Zheng Renhui was left to guard the Eastern Capital.

units.zh: 乙酉， 如潞州以攻汉。
units.en: On yiyou the emperor marched on Luzhou against Northern Han.
units.literal: On yiyou the emperor went to Luzhou to attack Han.

units.zh: 不曰伐，曲在周，不可以大小为言，故用两相攻为文。
units.en: The annals avoid saying “campaign against,” favoring Zhou without framing the war as large against small, and therefore write of two sides attacking each other.
units.literal: The text does not say “campaign against,” bending toward Zhou—it cannot speak in terms of large against small, and so uses the phrasing of two sides attacking each other.

units.zh: 壬辰，次泽州，阅兵于北郊。
units.en: On renchen he stopped at Ze Prefecture and held a military review north of the city.
units.literal: On renchen he halted at Ze Prefecture and reviewed troops at the northern suburb.

units.zh: 癸巳，及刘旻战于高原，败之，
units.en: On guisi he met Liu Chong on the high plain and routed him,
units.literal: On guisi he fought Liu Chong on the high plain and defeated him,

units.zh: 与其不屈于周，不与其称帝，故书姓名。
units.en: The text neither concedes his refusal to bow to Zhou nor calls him emperor, and so records him by personal name.
units.literal: Rather than recording his refusal to submit to Zhou, and rather than granting him the title of emperor, the annals therefore give his personal name.

units.zh: 追及于高平，又败之。
units.en: He chased Liu Chong to Gaoping and routed him again.
units.literal: He pursued to Gaoping and defeated him again.

units.zh: 丁酉，幸潞州。
units.en: On dingyou he went in person to Luzhou.
units.literal: On dingyou he visited Luzhou.

units.zh: 己亥，侍卫马军都指挥使樊爱能、步军都指 挥使何徽伏诛。
units.en: On jihai Fan Aineng, commander of the palace horse guard, and He Hui, commander of the palace foot guard, were put to death.
units.literal: On jihai Fan Aineng, commander-in-chief of the palace horse guard, and He Hui, commander-in-chief of the palace foot guard, were executed.

units.zh: 壬寅，天雄军节度使符彦卿为河东行营都部署。
units.en: On renyin Fu Yanqing, military commissioner of Tianxiong, was appointed overall commander of the Hedong campaign.
units.literal: On renyin Fu Yanqing, military commissioner of the Tianxiong army, was made overall commander of the eastern campaign against Hedong.

units.zh: 夏四月乙卯，葬 神圣文武恭肃孝皇帝于嵩陵。
units.en: On yimao in the fourth month Taizu, the Sagely, Divine, Martial, Civil, Reverent, Filial Emperor, was interred at Songling.
units.literal: On yimao in the fourth month of summer the Sagely, Divine, Martial, Civil, Reverent, Filial Emperor was buried at Songling.

units.zh: 在郑州新郑县。
units.en: The tomb lay at Xinzheng County in Zheng Prefecture.
units.literal: At Xinzheng County in Zheng Prefecture.

units.zh: 汾州防御使董希颜叛于汉来附。
units.en: Dong Xiyan, defense commissioner of Fen Prefecture, broke with Northern Han and defected to Zhou.
units.literal: Dong Xiyan, defense commissioner of Fen Prefecture, rebelled against Han and came to submit.

units.zh: 丙辰，辽州刺史张 汉超叛于汉来附。
units.en: On bingchen Liao Prefecture prefect Zhang Hanchao rebelled against Northern Han and submitted to Zhou.
units.literal: On bingchen Zhang Hanchao, prefect of Liao Prefecture, rebelled against Han and came to submit.

units.zh: 辛酉，取岚、宪州。
units.en: On xinyou Lan and Xian prefectures fell.
units.literal: On xinyou Lan and Xian prefectures were taken.

units.zh: 壬戌，立卫国夫人符氏为皇后。
units.en: On renxu Lady Fu of Wei was enthroned as empress.
units.literal: On renxu Lady Fu of the Wei state was installed as empress.

units.zh: 取石、沁州。
units.en: Shi and Qin prefectures were captured.
units.literal: Shi and Qin prefectures were taken.

units.zh: 乙丑，冯道薨。
units.en: On yichou Feng Dao died.
units.literal: On yichou Feng Dao died.

units.zh: 庚午，赦潞州流罪以下囚。
units.en: On gengwu Luzhou prisoners sentenced to exile or below were pardoned.
units.literal: On gengwu prisoners in Luzhou guilty of exile or less were pardoned.

units.zh: 如太原。
units.en: The emperor marched on Taiyuan.
units.literal: The emperor went to Taiyuan.

units.zh: 忻州监军李勍杀其刺史 赵皋，叛于汉来附。
units.en: Li Qiong, Xin Prefecture’s military supervisor, killed Prefect Zhao Gao, turned on Northern Han, and defected to Zhou.
units.literal: Li Qiong, military supervisor of Xin Prefecture, killed its prefect Zhao Gao, rebelled against Han, and came to submit.

units.zh: 五月丙子，代州守将郑处谦叛于汉来附，契丹救汉。
units.en: On bingzi in the fifth month Dai’s garrison commander Zheng Chuqian rebelled against Northern Han and submitted; the Khitan marched to relieve Han.
units.literal: On bingzi in the fifth month Zheng Chuqian, garrison commander of Dai Prefecture, rebelled against Han and came to submit; the Khitan came to rescue Han.

units.zh: 丁酉， 回鹘使因难敌略来。
units.en: On dingyou the Uyghur envoy Yinandielue arrived.
units.literal: On dingyou the Uyghur envoy Yinandielue came.

units.zh: 符彦卿及契丹战于忻口，败绩，先锋都指挥使史彦超死之。
units.en: Fu Yanqing met the Khitan at Xinkou and was beaten; Vanguard Commander Shi Yanchao fell in the fight.
units.literal: Fu Yanqing fought the Khitan at Xinkou and was defeated; Vanguard Commander Shi Yanchao died in the battle.

units.zh: 六月乙巳，班师。
units.en: On yisi in the sixth month the army marched home.
units.literal: On yisi in the sixth month the army withdrew.

units.zh: 乙丑，次新郑，遂拜嵩陵。
units.en: On yichou he stopped at Xinzheng and then visited Songling to mourn Taizu.
units.literal: On yichou he halted at Xinzheng and then paid respects at Songling.

units.zh: 庚午，至自太原。
units.en: On gengwu he came back from the Taiyuan campaign.
units.literal: On gengwu he returned from Taiyuan.

units.zh: 秋七月庚辰，阅 稼于南御庄。
units.en: On gengchen in the seventh month he inspected the harvest at the Southern Imperial Farm.
units.literal: On gengchen in the seventh month of autumn he inspected the crops at the Southern Imperial Estate.

units.zh: 癸巳，枢密院直学士、工部侍郎景范为中书侍郎、同中书门下平章 事，魏仁浦为枢密使。
units.en: On guisi Privy Council academician and Vice Minister of Works Jing Fan became vice director of the Secretariat and associate grand councilor; Wei Renpu was named privy commissioner.
units.literal: On guisi Jing Fan, academician of the Privy Council and vice minister of works, was made vice director of the Secretariat and associate grand councilor; Wei Renpu was made privy commissioner.

units.zh: 冬十月甲辰，杀左羽林大将军孟汉卿。
units.en: On jiachen in the tenth month Meng Hanqing, Grand General of the Left Feathered Forest, was put to death.
units.literal: On jiachen in the tenth month of winter Meng Hanqing, Grand General of the Left Feathered Forest, was executed.

units.zh: 二年五代乱世，以嗣君即位者五，而改元不依古者四，梁末帝、晋出帝即位逾年，宜改元而不改，又明年然后改，汉隐帝、周世宗皆仍称先帝年号，终其世不改，而本纪无讥者，但书其实，自见其失也。
units.en: In the second year: in the chaotic age of the Five Dynasties, five successors took the throne, yet four did not change the reign title according to ancient practice. Liang’s last emperor and Jin’s deposed emperor, more than a year after accession, ought to have changed the era name but did not, changing only the following year. Han’s Hidden Emperor and Zhou’s Shizong both kept their predecessors’ era names to the end without change, and the annals offer no censure—they simply record the facts, and the fault shows itself.
units.literal: In the second year: in the chaotic age of the Five Dynasties, five successors took the throne, yet four did not change the reign title according to ancient practice. The Last Emperor of Liang and the Deposed Emperor of Jin, more than a year after accession, ought to have changed the era name but did not, changing only the following year. The Hidden Emperor of Han and Shizong of Zhou both kept their predecessors’ era names to the end without change, and the annals offer no censure—they simply record the facts, and the fault shows itself.

units.zh: 春二月，御札求直言。
units.en: In the second month of spring an imperial note called for frank remonstrance.
units.literal: In the second month of spring an imperial note sought blunt counsel.

units.zh: 夏五月辛未，宣徽南院使向训、凤翔节度使王景伐蜀。
units.en: On xinwei in the fifth month Xiang Xun of the Southern Court and Fengxiang commissioner Wang Jing marched against Shu.
units.literal: On xinwei in the fifth month of summer Xiang Xun, Southern Court privy commissioner, and Wang Jing, military commissioner of Fengxiang, campaigned against Shu.

units.zh: 甲戌，大毁佛寺，禁民亲无侍养而为僧尼及私自度者。
units.en: On jiaxu the court demolished Buddhist temples on a large scale and forbade ordination without filial support or private tonsure.
units.literal: On jiaxu Buddhist temples were greatly destroyed, and the people were forbidden to become monks or nuns when their parents lacked support, or to take tonsure privately.

units.zh: 秋九月丙寅朔，颁铜禁。
units.en: On the new-year day bingyin in the ninth month the copper ban was issued.
units.literal: On the new-year day bingyin in the ninth month of autumn the copper ban was promulgated.

units.zh: 闰月癸丑，向训克秦州。
units.en: In the intercalary month on guichou Xiang Xun captured Qin Prefecture.
units.literal: In the intercalary month on guichou Xiang Xun took Qin Prefecture.

units.zh: 冬十月辛未，取成州。
units.en: On xinwei in the tenth month Cheng Prefecture fell.
units.literal: On xinwei in the tenth month of winter Cheng Prefecture was taken.

units.zh: 戊寅，高丽使王子太相融来。
units.en: On wuyin the Goryeo envoy Prince Tae Sang-yung arrived.
units.literal: On wuyin the Goryeo envoy Prince Tae Sang-yung came.

units.zh: 取阶州。
units.en: Jie Prefecture was captured.
units.literal: Jie Prefecture was taken.

units.zh: 十一月乙未朔，李穀为淮南道行营都部署以伐唐。
units.en: On the new-year day yimao in the eleventh month Li Gu was appointed overall commander of the Huainan campaign against Southern Tang.
units.literal: On the new-year day yimao in the eleventh month Li Gu was made overall commander of the Huainan circuit campaign to attack Tang.

units.zh: 戊申，王景克凤州。
units.en: On wushen Wang Jing captured Feng Prefecture.
units.literal: On wushen Wang Jing took Feng Prefecture.

units.zh: 十二月丙戌，郑仁诲薨。
units.en: On bingxu in the twelfth month Zheng Renhui died.
units.literal: On bingxu in the twelfth month Zheng Renhui died.

units.zh: 三年春正月，增筑京城。
units.en: In the first month of Xiande 3 the capital fortifications were extended.
units.literal: In the first month of spring in the third year the capital walls were enlarged.

units.zh: 庚子，向训留守东京。
units.en: On gengzi Xiang Xun was posted to guard the Eastern Capital.
units.literal: On gengzi Xiang Xun was left to guard the Eastern Capital.

units.zh: 壬寅，南征。
units.en: On renyin the emperor launched the southern campaign.
units.literal: On renyin the southern campaign began.

units.zh: 辛亥，侍卫亲 军都指挥使李重进及唐人战于正阳，败之。
units.en: On xinhai Li Chongjin, commander of the palace personal guard, met Southern Tang forces at Zhengyang and routed them.
units.literal: On xinhai Li Chongjin, commander-in-chief of the palace personal guard, fought the Tang at Zhengyang and defeated them.

units.zh: 甲寅，重进为淮南道行营都招讨使。
units.en: On jiayin Li Chongjin was appointed overall commander of the Huainan campaign.
units.literal: On jiayin Chongjin was made overall commander and recruiter for the Huainan circuit campaign.

units.zh: 二月丙寅，幸下蔡浮桥。
units.en: On bingyin in the second month he inspected the floating bridge at Xiacai.
units.literal: On bingyin in the second month the emperor visited the pontoon bridge at Xiacai.

units.zh: 壬申，克滁州。
units.en: On renshen Chu Prefecture fell.
units.literal: On renshen Chu Prefecture was taken.

units.zh: 甲戌，李景来求成，不答。
units.en: On jiaxu Li Jing of Southern Tang sued for peace; the court gave no reply.
units.literal: On jiaxu Li Jing came to sue for peace; no answer was given.

units.zh: 壬午，景使 其臣钟谟来奉表。
units.en: On renwu Li Jing sent his minister Zhong Mo with a formal petition.
units.literal: On renwu Jing sent his minister Zhong Mo to present a memorial.

units.zh: 丙戌，取扬州。
units.en: On bingxu Yang Prefecture was captured.
units.literal: On bingxu Yang Prefecture was taken.

units.zh: 辛卯，取泰州。
units.en: On xinmao Tai Prefecture fell.
units.literal: On xinmao Tai Prefecture was taken.

units.zh: 三月庚子，內外馬步軍都軍頭袁彥為竹龍都部署。
units.en: On gengzi Yuan Yan, chief of the inner and outer horse and foot forces, was named commander of the bamboo-dragon formation.
units.literal: On gengzi Yuan Yan, head of the inner and outer horse and foot armies, was made overall commander of the bamboo-dragon formation.

units.zh: 是月，取光、舒、常州。
units.en: That month Guang, Shu, and Chang prefectures were captured.
units.literal: That month Guang, Shu, and Chang prefectures were taken.

units.zh: 夏四月，常、泰州复入于唐。
units.en: In the fourth month Chang and Tai prefectures slipped back to Southern Tang control.
units.literal: In the fourth month of summer Chang and Tai prefectures returned to Tang.

units.zh: 五月 乙卯，至自淮南，赦京师囚。
units.en: On yimao in the fifth month he returned from Huainan and granted amnesty to capital prisoners.
units.literal: On yimao in the fifth month the emperor returned from Huainan and pardoned prisoners in the capital.

units.zh: 六月壬申，德音赦淮南囚。
units.en: On renshen in the sixth month a lenient edict freed Huainan prisoners.
units.literal: On renshen in the sixth month a merciful edict pardoned Huainan prisoners.

units.zh: 秋七月，皇后崩。
units.en: In the seventh month the empress died.
units.literal: In the seventh month of autumn the empress died.

units.zh: 扬、 光、舒、滁州复入于唐。
units.en: Yang, Guang, Shu, and Chu prefectures reverted to Southern Tang.
units.literal: Yang, Guang, Shu, and Chu prefectures returned to Tang.

units.zh: 八月乙丑，课民种木及韭。
units.en: On yichou in the eighth month the court ordered households to plant trees and leeks.
units.literal: On yichou in the eighth month the people were ordered to plant trees and leeks.

units.zh: 九月丙午，端明殿学士、左 散骑常侍王朴为尚书户部侍郎、枢密副使。
units.en: On bingwu in the ninth month Duanming Hall academician and Left Regular Attendant Wang Pu became Vice Minister of Revenue and vice privy commissioner.
units.literal: On bingwu in the ninth month Wang Pu, academician of the Duanming Hall and left regular attendant, was made vice minister of revenue and vice privy commissioner.

units.zh: 冬十月辛酉，葬宣懿皇后于懿陵。
units.en: On xinyou in the tenth month Empress Xuanyi was interred at Yiling.
units.literal: On xinyou in the tenth month of winter Empress Xuanyi was buried at Yiling.

units.zh: 十 一月庚寅，废诸祠不在祀典者。
units.en: On gengyin in the eleventh month unauthorized local cults were shut down.
units.literal: On gengyin in the eleventh month shrines not in the statutory canon of sacrifice were abolished.

units.zh: 乙巳，杀李景之臣孙晟。
units.en: On yisi Sun Sheng, a Southern Tang minister of Li Jing, was put to death.
units.literal: On yisi Sun Sheng, a minister of Li Jing, was executed.

units.zh: 四年春正月己丑朔，赦非死罪囚。
units.en: On the new-year day jichou in the first month of Xiande 4, all prisoners short of capital crimes were pardoned.
units.literal: On the new-year day jichou in the first month of spring in the fourth year, prisoners not guilty of capital crimes were pardoned.

units.zh: 二月甲戌，王朴留守东京。
units.en: On jiaxu in the second month Wang Pu was posted to guard the Eastern Capital.
units.literal: On jiaxu in the second month Wang Pu was left to guard the Eastern Capital.

units.zh: 乙亥，南征。
units.en: On yihai the emperor launched the southern campaign again.
units.literal: On yihai the southern campaign began.

units.zh: 三月丁未，克寿州。
units.en: On dingwei in the third month Shou Prefecture fell.
units.literal: On dingwei in the third month Shou Prefecture was taken.

units.zh: 不书刘仁赡降，事见死节传。盖仁赡实不降，故书周自克之尔。「克」者，难取之名也，寿难取，则见仁赡之节著，不书「死之」者，仁赡自以病死，以其至死守节，故列之死节传。
units.en: Liu Renzan’s surrender is not recorded; see the Biographies of Those Who Died for Principle. Renzan never truly surrendered, so the annals say Zhou “took” the city—the word for a hard-won capture. Shouzhou’s difficulty shows Renzan’s steadfastness. The text does not say he “died in battle” because he died of illness; having held firm to the end, he belongs in the martyrs’ biographies.
units.literal: The text does not record Liu Renzan’s surrender; the matter appears in the Biographies of Those Who Died for Principle. Renzan in fact did not surrender, and so the annals say Zhou took the city by force. “Took by force” is the term for what is hard to capture; that Shou was hard to capture shows Renzan’s integrity. It does not say “died in the fighting” because Renzan died of illness; because he held the city to the end and kept his integrity, he is listed among those who died for principle.

units.zh: 夏四月己巳，至自寿州。
units.en: On jisi in the fourth month he returned from the Shouzhou campaign.
units.literal: On jisi in the fourth month of summer the emperor returned from Shou Prefecture.

units.zh: 己卯，放降卒八百归于蜀。
units.en: On jimao eight hundred captives were sent home to Shu.
units.literal: On jimao eight hundred surrendered soldiers were released to Shu.

units.zh: 癸未， 追册彭城郡夫人刘氏为皇后。
units.en: On guiwei Lady Liu of Pengcheng was posthumously enthroned as empress.
units.literal: On guiwei Lady Liu of Pengcheng commandery was posthumously installed as empress.

units.zh: 五月丙申，杀密州防御使侯希进。
units.en: On bingshen in the fifth month Mi Prefecture defense commissioner Hou Xijin was put to death.
units.literal: On bingshen in the fifth month Hou Xijin, defense commissioner of Mi Prefecture, was executed.

units.zh: 秋八月乙亥，李 穀罢，王朴为枢密使。
units.en: On yihai in the eighth month Li Gu left office and Wang Pu became privy commissioner.
units.literal: On yihai in the eighth month of autumn Li Gu was dismissed; Wang Pu was made privy commissioner.

units.zh: 癸未，蜀人来归我濮州刺史胡立。
units.en: On guiwei Shu sent back Hu Li, Zhou’s prefect of Pu Prefecture.
units.literal: On guiwei Shu returned Hu Li, our prefect of Pu Prefecture.

units.zh: 冬十月己巳，王朴留守 东京，三司使张美为大内都点检。
units.en: On jisi in the tenth month Wang Pu guarded the Eastern Capital while Zhang Mei, head of the three fiscal departments, was named chief inspector of the inner palace.
units.literal: On jisi in the tenth month of winter Wang Pu was left to guard the Eastern Capital; Zhang Mei, commissioner of the three departments, was made chief inspector of the inner palace.

units.zh: 壬申，南征。
units.en: On renshen the southern campaign resumed.
units.literal: On renshen the southern campaign began.

units.zh: 十二月乙卯，泗州守将范再遇叛 于唐，以其州来降。
units.en: On yimao in the twelfth month Si Prefecture commander Fan Zaiyu turned on Southern Tang and surrendered his prefecture.
units.literal: On yimao in the twelfth month Fan Zaiyu, garrison commander of Si Prefecture, rebelled against Tang and surrendered the prefecture.

units.zh: 庚申，濠州团练使郭廷谓以其州来降。
units.en: On gengshen Hao Prefecture training commissioner Guo Tingwei surrendered his prefecture.
units.literal: On gengshen Guo Tingwei, training commissioner of Hao Prefecture, surrendered his prefecture.

units.zh: 身居其地而来降者书「附」，再遇、廷谓虽以地降，既降而不居其地，故不书「附」而书「降」。廷谓不书「叛」，事见南唐世家。
units.en: Defectors who still held their posts are recorded as “attached.” Zaiyu and Tingwei surrendered territory but did not stay to hold it, so the text says “surrendered” rather than “attached.” Tingwei is not called a “rebel”; see the Southern Tang house chronicle.
units.literal: Those who lived in the territory and came to submit are recorded with “attached.” Although Zaiyu and Tingwei surrendered their prefectures, once they surrendered they did not remain in their territory, and so the text does not say “attached” but says “surrendered.” Tingwei is not recorded as “rebelled”; the matter is treated in the Southern Tang house chronicle.

units.zh: 丁丑，取泰州。
units.en: On dingchou Tai Prefecture was captured.
units.literal: On dingchou Tai Prefecture was taken.

units.zh: 五年春正月丁亥，取海州。
units.en: On dinghai in the first month of Xiande 5 Hai Prefecture fell.
units.literal: On dinghai in the first month of spring in the fifth year Hai Prefecture was taken.

units.zh: 壬辰，取静海军。
units.en: On renchen the Jinghai command was captured.
units.literal: On renchen the Jinghai army was taken.

units.zh: 丁未，克楚州，守将张彦卿、 郑昭业死之。
units.en: On dingwei Chu Prefecture fell; its defenders Zhang Yanqing and Zheng Zhaoye died in the assault.
units.literal: On dingwei Chu Prefecture was taken; garrison commanders Zhang Yanqing and Zheng Zhaoye died in the fighting.

units.zh: 自四年十二月辛酉攻之，彦卿等坚守四十余日乃克之，其不走不降可知，故予其死。然所贵者死尔，本纪著其大节可矣。
units.en: The siege began on xinyou in the twelfth month of the fourth year. Yanqing and the others held out more than forty days before the city fell—they plainly neither fled nor surrendered, so the text records their deaths. What counts is dying in place; the annals need only note their steadfastness.
units.literal: The assault began on xinyou in the twelfth month of the fourth year; Yanqing and the others held firm for more than forty days before the city fell—clearly they neither fled nor surrendered, and so the text grants them “died in the fighting.” What matters is death itself; the annals need only record their great integrity.

units.zh: 二月甲寅，取雄州。
units.en: On jiayin Xiong Prefecture was captured.
units.literal: On jiayin Xiong Prefecture was taken.

units.zh: 丁卯，如揚州。
units.en: On dingmao the emperor traveled to Yang Prefecture.
units.literal: On dingmao the emperor went to Yang Prefecture.

units.zh: 癸酉，如瓜洲。
units.en: On guiyou he went on to Guazhou.
units.literal: On guiyou the emperor went to Guazhou.

units.zh: 三月壬午朔， 如泰州。
units.en: On the new-year day renwu in the third month he went to Tai Prefecture.
units.literal: On the new-year day renwu in the third month the emperor went to Tai Prefecture.

units.zh: 丁亥，复如扬州。
units.en: On dinghai he went back to Yang Prefecture.
units.literal: On dinghai he returned to Yang Prefecture.

units.zh: 辛卯，幸迎銮。
units.en: On xinmao he toured Yingluan.
units.literal: On xinmao he visited Yingluan.

units.zh: 己亥，克淮南十有四州，以江为界。
units.en: On jihai fourteen Huainan prefectures were secured, the Yangzi River set as the border.
units.literal: On jihai fourteen Huainan prefectures were taken, with the Yangzi as the boundary.

units.zh: 并前所得通十四州耳，书之，见其本志所止。
units.en: With earlier gains, fourteen prefectures in all—the record shows the limit of his original aim.
units.literal: Together with what had been taken earlier, fourteen prefectures in all; the text records this to show where his original ambition stopped.

units.zh: 三月辛亥，李景来买宴。
units.en: On xinhai in the third month Li Jing came in person to tender submission at a feast.
units.literal: On xinhai in the third month Li Jing came to buy a feast.

units.zh: 四月庚申，祔五室神主于新庙。
units.en: On gengshen in the fourth month the five ancestral tablets were installed in the new imperial temple.
units.literal: On gengshen in the fourth month the spirit tablets of the five chambers were enshrined in the new temple.

units.zh: 壬申，至自淮南，回鹘、 达靼遣使者来。
units.en: On renshen he returned from Huainan; envoys arrived from the Uyghurs and the Tatars.
units.literal: On renshen the emperor returned from Huainan; Uyghur and Tatar envoys came.

units.zh: 六月辛未，放降卒四千六百于唐。
units.en: On xinwei in the sixth month 4,600 captives were sent back to Southern Tang.
units.literal: On xinwei in the sixth month four thousand six hundred surrendered soldiers were released to Tang.

units.zh: 秋七月乙酉，水部员外郎韩彦 卿市铜于高丽。
units.en: On yiyou in the seventh month Han Yanqing of the Water Ministry was dispatched to buy copper in Goryeo.
units.literal: On yiyou in the seventh month of autumn Han Yanqing, outer office director of the water ministry, was sent to purchase copper in Goryeo.

units.zh: 丁亥，颁《均田图》。
units.en: On dinghai the court issued the Equal-Field Diagram.
units.literal: On dinghai the Equal-Field Diagram was promulgated.

units.zh: 九月，占城国王释利因德缦使莆诃散来。
units.en: In the ninth month the king of Champa, Shili Yinde Man, dispatched the envoy Puhesan.
units.literal: In the ninth month the king of Champa, Shili Yinde Man, sent the envoy Puhesan.

units.zh: 冬十月丁酉，括民租。
units.en: In winter, on dingyou in the tenth month, the court levied grain rents from the people.
units.literal: In winter, in the tenth month on dingyou, the people’s grain rents were levied.

units.zh: 十一月庚戌，作《通礼》、《正乐》。
units.en: In the eleventh month on gengxu the court compiled the Comprehensive Rites and the Correct Music.
units.literal: In the eleventh month on gengxu the Comprehensive Rites and Correct Music were compiled.

units.zh: 十二月丙戌，罢州 县课户、俸户。
units.en: In the twelfth month on bingxu the court abolished tax-account and salary households in prefectures and counties.
units.literal: In the twelfth month on bingxu tax-account households and salary households in prefectures and counties were abolished.

units.zh: 六年春正月，高丽王昭遣使者来。
units.en: In the first month of Xiande 6 King Zhao of Goryeo sent envoys.
units.literal: In the first month of spring in the sixth year King Zhao of Goryeo sent envoys.

units.zh: 辛酉，女真使阿辨来。
units.en: On xinyou the Jurchen envoy A Bian arrived.
units.literal: On xinyou the Jurchen envoy A Bian came.

units.zh: 三月己酉，甘州回鹘来献玉，却之。
units.en: On jiyou in the third month the Ganzhou Uyghurs offered jade; the court declined it.
units.literal: On jiyou in the third month the Ganzhou Uyghurs came to present jade; it was refused.

units.zh: 庚申，王朴薨。
units.en: On gengshen Wang Pu died.
units.literal: On gengshen Wang Pu died.

units.zh: 丙寅，宣徽南院使吴延祚留守东京。
units.en: On bingyin Wu Yanzuo, Southern Court privy commissioner, was posted to guard the Eastern Capital.
units.literal: On bingyin Wu Yanzuo, Southern Court privy commissioner, was left to guard the Eastern Capital.

units.zh: 癸酉，停给铜鱼。
units.en: On guiyou the court stopped issuing bronze tally-fish.
units.literal: On guiyou the issuance of bronze tally-fish was halted.

units.zh: 甲戌，北征。
units.en: On jiaxu the emperor launched the northern campaign.
units.literal: On jiaxu the northern campaign began.

units.zh: 是月，吴延祚为左骁卫上将军、枢密使。
units.en: That month Wu Yanzuo became Grand General of the Upper Left Tiger Guard and privy commissioner.
units.literal: That month Wu Yanzuo was made Grand General of the Upper Left Tiger Guard and privy commissioner.

units.zh: 夏四月壬辰，取乾宁军。
units.en: On renchen in the fourth month Qianning command fell.
units.literal: On renchen in the fourth month of summer Qianning command was taken.

units.zh: 辛丑，取益津关，以为霸州。
units.en: On xinchou Yijin Pass was captured and established as Ba Prefecture.
units.literal: On xinchou Yijin Pass was taken and made Ba Prefecture.

units.zh: 癸卯，取瓦桥关，以为雄州。
units.en: On guimao Waqiao Pass was captured and established as Xiong Prefecture.
units.literal: On guimao Waqiao Pass was taken and made Xiong Prefecture.

units.zh: 州县废置不书，此书，重复中国故地。世宗下三关，瓦桥、益津以建州及见，淤口关止置寨，故旧史、实录皆阙不书，遂不见其取得时日，今信安军是也。
units.en: Changes to prefectures and counties are usually omitted; here they are recorded because old Chinese lands were recovered. Shizong took the Three Passes: Waqiao and Yijin were made prefectures and noted, but Yankou was only fortified, so earlier histories and veritable records left the captures undated—today’s Xin’an command is an example.
units.literal: The abolition and establishment of prefectures and counties is normally not recorded; here it is recorded because Chinese territory was recovered. Shizong took the Three Passes—Waqiao and Yijin were made prefectures and noted as such, while Yankou Pass was only garrisoned—so the old histories and veritable records all omit the record and the dates of capture cannot be seen; present-day Xin’an command is the case.

units.zh: 五月乙巳朔，取瀛州。
units.en: On the new-year day yisi in the fifth month Ying Prefecture fell.
units.literal: On the new-year day yisi in the fifth month Ying Prefecture was taken.

units.zh: 复中国故地，故不书「契丹」。
units.en: Because this was recovery of Chinese territory, the text does not say “Khitan.”
units.literal: Chinese territory was recovered, and so the text does not say “Khitan.”

units.zh: 甲戌，至自雄州。
units.en: On jiaxu he returned from the Xiongzhou campaign.
units.literal: On jiaxu the emperor returned from Xiong Prefecture.

units.zh: 六月癸未，立皇后符氏，符氏无国爵，不曰立符氏为皇后，嫌同于不正也。盖其位先定而后娶，故书曰「立皇后符氏」，文理宜然，无褒贬也。
units.en: On guiwei in the sixth month Empress Lady Fu was enthroned. She held no state title, so the annals avoid saying “installed Lady Fu as empress” lest it seem irregular. Her status had been settled before the wedding, so the phrasing “installed Empress Lady Fu” is formally correct and carries no judgment.
units.literal: On guiwei in the sixth month Lady Fu was installed as empress. Because Lady Fu had no state enfeoffment, the text does not say “installed Lady Fu as empress,” avoiding the appearance of impropriety. Her rank had been fixed before the marriage, and so the wording “installed Empress Lady Fu” is fitting in form and carries no praise or blame.

units.zh: 封子宗训为梁王、宗让燕国公。
units.en: He enfeoffed Zongxun as Prince of Liang and Zongrang as Duke of Yan.
units.literal: His sons Zongxun and Zongrang were enfeoffed as Prince of Liang and Duke of Yan respectively.

units.zh: 戊子，占城使莆诃散来。
units.en: On wuzi the Champa envoy Puhesan arrived.
units.literal: On wuzi the Champa envoy Puhesan came.

units.zh: 己丑，范质、王溥参知枢密院事，魏仁浦同中书门下平章事。
units.en: On jichou Fan Zhi and Wang Pu joined Privy Council affairs, and Wei Renpu became associate grand councilor.
units.literal: On jichou Fan Zhi and Wang Pu were made participants in Privy Council affairs, and Wei Renpu became associate grand councilor.

units.zh: 癸巳，皇帝崩于滋德殿。
units.en: On guisi the emperor died in Zide Hall.
units.literal: On guisi the emperor died in Zide Hall.

units.zh: 年三十九。
units.en: He was thirty-nine.
units.literal: He was thirty-nine years old.

units.zh: 恭皇帝，世宗第四子宗训也。
units.en: Emperor Gong was Zongxun, the fourth son of Shizong.
units.literal: Emperor Gong was Zongxun, Shizong’s fourth son.

units.zh: 世宗即位，大臣请封皇子为王，世宗谦抑久之。
units.en: After Shizong’s accession his ministers urged that the princes be enfeoffed as kings, but he long refused out of modest restraint.
units.literal: When Shizong took the throne, his ministers asked that imperial sons be enfeoffed as kings; Shizong declined modestly for a long time.

units.zh: 及北取三关，遇疾还京师，始封宗训梁王，时年七岁。
units.en: When he marched north to recover the Three Passes he fell ill and returned to the capital; only then did he enfeoff Zongxun as Prince of Liang, at the age of seven.
units.literal: When he marched north to take the Three Passes he fell ill and returned to the capital; only then was Zongxun enfeoffed as Prince of Liang, aged seven.

units.zh: 显德六年六月癸巳，世宗崩。
units.en: On guisi in the sixth month of Xiande 6 Shizong died.
units.literal: On guisi in the sixth month of Xiande 6 Shizong died.

units.zh: 甲午，皇帝即位于柩前。
units.en: On jiawu the new emperor took the throne before the bier.
units.literal: On jiawu the emperor acceded before the coffin.

units.zh: 癸卯，范质为大行皇帝山陵使，翰林学士窦俨为礼仪使，兵部尚书张昭为卤簿使，御史中丞边归谠为仪仗使，宣徽南院使、判开封府事昝居润为桥道顿递使。
units.en: On guimao Fan Zhi was named mausoleum commissioner for the late emperor; Dou Yan, Hanlin academician, oversaw ritual; Zhang Zhao, Minister of War, insignia; Bian Guidang, Vice Censor-in-Chief, ceremonial guards; and Zan Jurun, Southern Court privy commissioner acting as mayor of Kaifeng, bridges, roads, and relays.
units.literal: On guimao Fan Zhi was made commissioner for the late emperor’s mausoleum; Hanlin academician Dou Yan, commissioner of ritual; Minister of War Zhang Zhao, commissioner of insignia; Vice Censor-in-Chief Bian Guidang, commissioner of ceremonial guards; and Southern Court Privy Commissioner and acting Mayor of Kaifeng Zan Jurun, commissioner of bridges, roads, and relay stations.

units.zh: 秋七月丁未，户部尚书李涛为山陵副使，度支郎中卢億为判官。
units.en: On dingwei in the seventh month Li Tao, Minister of Revenue, became vice mausoleum commissioner, and Lu Yi of the expenditure bureau served as adjutant.
units.literal: On dingwei in the seventh month of autumn Li Tao, Minister of Revenue, was made vice commissioner for the mausoleum, and Lu Yi, outer office director of the expenditure bureau, was made adjutant.

units.zh: 八月庚寅，封弟熙让为曹王，熙谨纪王，熙诲蕲王。
units.en: On gengyin his younger brothers Xi Rang, Xi Jin, and Xi Hui were enfeoffed as Princes of Cao, Ji, and Qi.
units.literal: On gengyin younger brother Xi Rang was enfeoffed as Prince of Cao, Xi Jin as Prince of Ji, and Xi Hui as Prince of Qi.

units.zh: 壬寅，高丽遣使者来。
units.en: On renyin envoys arrived from Goryeo.
units.literal: On renyin Goryeo sent envoys.

units.zh: 九月丙寅，左骁卫大将军戴交使于高丽。
units.en: On bingyin in the ninth month Dai Jiao, Grand General of the Left Tiger Guard, was dispatched to Goryeo.
units.literal: On bingyin in the ninth month Dai Jiao, Grand General of the Left Tiger Guard, was sent as envoy to Goryeo.

units.zh: 冬十一月壬寅，葬睿武孝文皇帝于庆陵。
units.en: On renyin in the eleventh month Shizong, the Sagacious Martial Filial Civil Emperor, was interred at Qingling.
units.literal: On renyin in the eleventh month of winter the Sagacious Martial Filial Civil Emperor was buried at Qingling.

units.zh: 在郑州管城县。
units.en: The tomb lay at Guancheng County in Zheng Prefecture.
units.literal: At Guancheng County in Zheng Prefecture.

units.zh: 高丽遣使者来。
units.en: Goryeo sent envoys again.
units.literal: Goryeo sent envoys.

units.zh: 七年春正月甲辰，逊于位。
units.en: In the first month of spring in the seventh year, on jiachen, he abdicated the throne.
units.literal: In the seventh year, spring, first month, on jiachen, he abdicated the throne.

units.zh: 宋兴。
units.en: The Song arose.
units.literal: The Song arose.

units.zh: 五代之亡，所书不同，随事为文尔。「梁亡」见唐之速，「汉亡」见周之迟也。
units.en: Each dynasty’s fall is worded differently as the facts require. “The Liang perished” shows Tang’s swift rise; “Han perished” shows Zhou’s delay.
units.literal: The endings of the Five Dynasties are written differently, phrased according to the circumstances. “The Liang perished” shows how swiftly Tang arose; “Han perished” shows how slowly Zhou came.

units.zh: 唐欺天下以讨贼，周欺天下以立贇。
units.en: Tang fooled the empire with talk of punishing rebels; Zhou fooled it with talk of enthroning Yun.
units.literal: Tang deceived the realm under the pretense of punishing rebels; Zhou deceived the realm under the pretense of enthroning Yun.

units.zh: 故书「梁亡」，见唐之立速，则知其志不在讨贼也；「汉亡」见周之立迟，则知立贇者伪也。
units.en: So “the Liang perished” exposes Tang’s haste and its sham crusade; “Han perished” exposes Zhou’s delay and the fraud of enthroning Yun.
units.literal: Therefore “the Liang perished” shows Tang’s swift establishment and reveals that its aim was not to punish rebels; “Han perished” shows Zhou’s slow establishment and reveals that enthroning Yun was a sham.

units.zh: 唐亡无辞，庄宗之弑，唐已亡矣，而明宗又称唐，愍帝之奔，唐又亡矣，而废帝又称唐，其亡也不可以屡书，故不书也。
units.en: Later Tang’s end cannot be repeated: after Zhuangzong’s murder Mingzong still claimed Tang; after Min-di’s flight the deposed emperor did too. The annals cannot record every death, so they omit them.
units.literal: Tang’s fall has no wording: Zhuangzong was assassinated and Tang was already dead, yet Mingzong still called himself Tang; Min-di fled and Tang died again, yet the Deposed Emperor still called himself Tang. Its deaths cannot be written again and again, and so they are not written.

units.zh: 晋亡曰「契丹灭晋」，明言以深戒。
units.en: Jin’s end reads “the Khitan destroyed Jin”—stated plainly as warning.
units.literal: Jin’s fall is written as “the Khitan destroyed Jin,” stating it plainly as a stern warning.

units.zh: 周曰「逊于位」，逊，顺也，能顺乎天命也。
units.en: Zhou is written as “abdicated the throne”—yielding, obeying Heaven’s mandate.
units.literal: Zhou is written as “abdicated the throne”; to abdicate is to yield, to yield to Heaven’s mandate.

units.zh: 呜呼，五代本纪备矣！备，谓丧乱之事，无所不有。
units.en: Alas! The Five Dynasties annals stand complete—complete meaning that every calamity of the age is recorded.
units.literal: Alas! The annals of the Five Dynasties are complete—complete in the sense that nothing of disorder and ruin is missing.

units.zh: 君臣之际，可胜道哉。
units.en: What can fully be told of the bond between ruler and subject!
units.literal: How much can be told of what passed between ruler and subject!

units.zh: 梁之友珪反，唐戕克宁而杀存 乂、从璨，则父子骨肉之恩，几何其不绝矣。
units.en: When Liang’s Yougui rebelled, Later Tang slew Kening and put Cunyi and Congcan to death—the tie between father and son, bone and blood, was all but severed.
units.literal: When Liang’s Yougui rebelled, Tang slaughtered Kening and killed Cunyi and Congcan—then how nearly was the bond of father and son, flesh and blood, cut off!

units.zh: 太妃薨而辍朝，立刘氏、冯氏为皇 后，则夫妇之伦几何其不乖而不至于禽兽矣。
units.en: They halted court when the imperial dowager died, yet enthroned Liu and Feng as empresses—the marriage bond was all but wrecked, not far from the conduct of beasts.
units.literal: When the imperial dowager died they suspended court, yet enthroned Liu and Feng as empresses—then how nearly were the norms of husband and wife overturned short of outright beastliness!

units.zh: 寒食野祭而焚纸钱，居丧改元而用 乐，杀马延及任圜，则礼乐刑政几何其不坏矣。
units.en: Cold Food sacrifices in the open with spirit money burned, a new reign title proclaimed amid mourning while music played, Ma Yan and Ren Yuan put to death—ritual, music, punishments, and policy were all but destroyed.
units.literal: Cold Food rites in the wild with paper money burned, changing the era name during mourning while using music, killing Ma Yanji and Ren Yuan—then how nearly were ritual, music, punishments, and governance ruined!

units.zh: 至于赛雷山、传箭而扑马，则中 国几何其不夷狄矣。
units.en: Thunder-Mountain contests, passing the arrow, trampling horses—the Middle Kingdom had all but turned barbarian.
units.literal: As for the Thunder-Mountain contest, passing arrows and trampling horses—then how nearly had the Middle Kingdom ceased to be Chinese!

units.zh: 可谓乱世也欤！
units.en: Truly it may be called an age of chaos!
units.literal: It may be called an age of chaos indeed!

units.zh: 而世宗区区五六年间，取秦陇，平淮右，复 三关，威武之声震慑夷夏，而方内延儒学文章之士，考制度、修《通礼》、定《 正乐》、议《刑统》，其制作之法皆可施于后世。
units.en: Yet in only five or six years Shizong seized Qin and Long, pacified the Huai west, and recovered the Three Passes; his martial fame shook both barbarians and Chinese, while within the realm he gathered Confucian scholars, examined institutions, compiled the Comprehensive Rites, fixed the Correct Music, and debated the Penal Code—institutions fit to govern generations yet unborn.
units.literal: Yet in a mere five or six years Shizong took Qin and Long, pacified the Huai’s right bank, recovered the Three Passes; his martial renown shook barbarian and Chinese alike, while within the realm he welcomed Confucian scholars, examined institutions, compiled the Comprehensive Rites, fixed the Correct Music, and debated the Penal Code—what he wrought could all be applied in later ages.

units.zh: 其为人明达英果，论议伟然。
units.en: He was clear-sighted and resolute, bold in counsel and grand in debate.
units.literal: In person he was clear-sighted, resolute, and bold; his counsels were magnanimous.

units.zh: 即位之明年，废天下佛寺三千三百三十六。
units.en: The year after he took the throne he abolished 3,336 Buddhist temples across the realm.
units.literal: The year after his accession he abolished 3,336 Buddhist temples throughout the realm.

units.zh: 是时中国乏钱，乃诏悉毁天下铜佛像 以铸钱，尝曰：「吾闻佛说以身世为妄，而以利人为急，使其真身尚在，苟利于 世，犹欲割截，况此铜像，岂其所惜哉？」
units.en: Coin was scarce in China then, and an edict ordered every copper Buddha image in the realm melted for cash. He once said, “I have heard the Buddha call body and worldly life illusion, and urge us to benefit others—had his true body remained, and the world gained from cutting it apart, he would still have it severed; how much less would he spare these copper statues?”
units.literal: China then lacked coin; an edict ordered all copper Buddha images throughout the realm destroyed to cast cash. He once said: “I have heard that Buddha teaches the bodily world is illusion and that benefiting others is urgent—even if his true body remained, were it useful to the world he would cut it away; how much less these copper images—would he cherish them?”

units.zh: 由是群臣皆不敢言。
units.en: After that none of his ministers dared object.
units.literal: Thereafter none of his ministers dared speak against it.

units.zh: 尝夜读书，见唐 元稹《均田图》，慨然叹曰：「此致治之本也，王者之政自此始！」
units.en: One night, reading, he came upon Tang Yuan Zhen’s Equal-Field Diagram and sighed: “Here is the root of good order—royal government begins with this!”
units.literal: Reading by night he came upon Tang Yuan Zhen’s Equal-Field Diagram and sighed with emotion: “This is the root of good order—royal government begins here!”

units.zh: 乃诏颁其图 法，使吏民先习知之，期以一岁，大均天下之田，其规为志意岂小哉！
units.en: He ordered the diagram’s rules published so officials and people could study them in advance, setting a year to equalize fields across the realm—an ambition that was anything but small!
units.literal: He then ordered the diagram’s regulations promulgated so officials and people might learn them beforehand; within a year he meant to equalize fields throughout the realm—a scheme whose ambition was no small thing!

units.zh: 其伐南唐， 问宰相李穀以计策；
units.en: When he marched against Southern Tang he consulted Chancellor Li Gu on strategy;
units.literal: When he campaigned against Southern Tang he asked Chancellor Li Gu for strategy;

units.zh: 后克淮南，出穀疏，使学士陶穀为赞，而盛以锦囊，尝置之 坐侧。
units.en: After Huainan fell he produced Gu’s memorial, had Academician Tao Gu compose an encomium, and kept it in a brocade pouch at his side.
units.literal: After taking Huainan he produced Gu’s memorial, had Academician Tao Gu write a eulogy, and kept it in a brocade bag at his seat.

units.zh: 其英武之材可谓雄杰，及其虚心听纳，用人不疑，岂非所谓贤主哉！
units.en: His martial gifts were truly heroic; that he listened with an open mind and employed men without suspicion—was this not the mark of a worthy sovereign?
units.literal: His martial talent was truly heroic, and his open mind in listening, his trust without doubt in appointing men—was this not what is called an enlightened ruler?

units.zh: 其北 取三关，兵不血刃，而史家犹讥其轻社稷之重，而侥幸一胜于仓卒，殊不知其料 强弱、较彼我而乘述律之殆，得不可失之机，此非明于决胜者，孰能至哉？
units.en: In recovering the Three Passes his armies scarcely drew blood, yet historians still faulted him for gambling the altars of state on a rash stroke—never seeing that he had gauged strength and weakness, weighed foe against self, and struck when Shulü was failing, seizing a moment that would not come again. Who but a man clear in the art of decision could have done it?
units.literal: In taking the Three Passes in the north his armies scarcely drew blood, yet historians still mocked him for slighting the weight of the state and gambling on a hasty victory—little knowing he had weighed strength against weakness, compared foe with self, seized the moment when Shulü was near collapse, and grasped an opportunity not to be missed—who but one clear about decisive victory could have done this?

units.zh: 诚非 史氏之所及也！
units.en: Truly the historians themselves could not have matched him!
units.literal: Truly this was beyond what mere chroniclers could reach!
